summary.answer: Takes menu f1_arg0, controller f1_arg1 and eight layout bounds f1_arg2..f1_arg9; calls LUI.UIElement.new and sets the literal class/id/sound. Creates the tinted AARLevelCommonBoxes child and a partially transparent Fui image with the literal material/shader setup. Registers self's close pointer. There is no hacking algorithm in this selected builder. Exact child order: SquareOthers, FuiR01. All layout/property/asset values and each callback body are retained in the ordered trace. Calls the optional same-file-or-unresolved PostLoadFunc at its exact source position, then returns self; a same name in another file supplies no binding. Base/child lifetime, model/event/animation delivery and native asset behavior remain external unless a reused exact provider contract explicitly supplies the bounded fact.

summary.answer: Builds game-status decorative panels, kills/players-left children, teammate/spectator counts and left/right endgame status lists. Nonnil aliveTeammateCount/spectatorsCount are sent directly to text. Each status display filters right-solo gameInformation versus left-solo hudGameStat, then assigns its exact endgame datasource names. Registers close, optional postload, returns self. This displays supplied data without computing ranks, population or results.
